_about.purpose: Measure the fuzzy tier (tier 2) with graded typos. The original set was saturated: recall stayed 1.000 from threshold 80 to 96, so the sweep was flat and could not justify the 88.0 default.
_about.positives: Synthetic typos at controlled edit distance 1/2/3, embedded in realistic carrier sentences.
_about.hard_negatives: Real English words common in resumes that sit within small edit distance of a skill name ('was'/aws, 'get'/git, 'code'/node, 'reacts'/react, 'trust'/rust).
_about.reading_the_result: A useful threshold recovers most distance-1 typos, some distance-2, and rejects the hard negatives. If recall is flat across thresholds the set is saturated again.
